FAQ.subHeader: Quick answers to common questions about our products and services.

q1.question: How does Urator automate the onboarding process for new members?
q1.answer: Once a member successfully completes their payment through your Midtrans checkout (via QRIS, Virtual Account, or E-Wallet), Urator instantly generates a one-time secure invite link. The system automatically sends this link to the member and grants them access without requiring any manual approval or confirmation from you.

q2.question: Does Urator hold or take a cut from my community's revenue?
q2.answer: No, never. Urator utilizes a direct integration system. By connecting your own Midtrans API key to your Urator dashboard, 100% of your subscription revenue flows straight from your members into your personal or business bank account instantly.

q3.question: What happens if a member forgets to renew or their subscription expires?
q3.answer: Urator works as your bulletproof 24/7 digital gatekeeper. Powered by ultra-fast backend queues, the system continuously monitors subscription validity. The exact millisecond a subscription lapses, the system triggers an autopilot command to instantly kick the inactive member from your private group or channel.

q4.question: Can I use my own Telegram bot brand and customize its commands?
q4.answer: Absolutely! You can connect your own custom Telegram bot created via BotFather. Urator allows you to completely customize welcome messages, interactive button labels, and custom commands (like /signal, /rules, etc.) to match your community's unique branding.

q5.question: How does Urator prevent members from leaking or sharing the invite links?
q5.answer: Standard Telegram links can be easily forwarded, but Urator solves this by generating Unique Secure Links for each member. These links are restricted to a single use and tied directly to that specific member's Telegram ID, rendering them completely useless if forwarded or shared with free-riders.

q6.question: Can I test the platform before launching it to my real audience?
q6.answer: Yes, you can. Urator provides a Sandbox Mode that integrates perfectly with Midtrans Sandbox. This allows you to completely simulate mock payments, test your bot's automated gatekeeping, and configure custom commands safely using play money before going live.
